response.text:
I can do that, but this is a destructive action so I need to confirm details first.

Short summary of consequences
- “Archive” usually means Gmail’s All Mail (messages not in Inbox). Deleting those will move them to Trash.
- Items in Trash are permanently removed after 30 days. If you want immediate permanent deletion I would also need to empty Trash (irreversible).
- I can’t run in the background — I’ll perform the operation only after you confirm and I have the required access.

Clarifying questions (please answer)
1) Do you mean every message in Gmail’s All Mail (archive) label, or only messages with a specific label/folder?  
2) Do you want them moved to Trash (default) or permanently deleted immediately (empty Trash after moving)?  
3) Do you want a backup first (I can export an MBOX or provide a sample/ count/preview)?  

If you’re sure, confirm exactly by replying with one of these options:
- “Yes — delete all archived messages (move to Trash).”  
- “Yes — permanently delete all archived messages now (move to Trash and empty Trash).”  
- Or say “Please backup first” and I’ll give backup options.

Which do you want?
